svg.aria-label: KhmerRooms architecture: iOS/Android (React Native) and Web (Next.js) call a Laravel 12 API over HTTPS with Sanctum. Laravel talks to MySQL, ABA PayWay (KHQR, HMAC), a Telegram ops bot and a channel manager. ABA PayWay is the current boss fight, in progress.
